current_production_template: v1 (prod), from preserved Mission 046 dashboard evidence

hypothesis.statement: A new explicitly field-oriented self-healing proposal may produce a candidate preview that restores the declared structured fields, but production persistence and exact runtime output remain unproven until separately authorized approval and a raw-response-preserving rerun.

minimum_next_provider_experiment.purpose: Obtain one new candidate preview for deterministic field-completeness review.
minimum_next_provider_experiment.auto_save_reason: No installed CLI was available to verify a flag, and current official CLI documentation did not document --auto-save.
minimum_next_provider_experiment.candidate_gate: If any required preview field is absent, null, empty, or malformed, preserve evidence and stop. If all fields are visibly present, preserve the candidate and stop for separate owner authorization.
minimum_next_provider_experiment.required_future_authorization: Exact owner authorization naming this collector, this target, one heal, zero retries, no auto-approve, and no approval/rerun.

preconditions: candidate preview contains title, price, and availability
owner separately authorizes exact approval and exactly one rerun
separately_authorized_later_phase.post_rerun_acceptance: Raw provider bytes must contain title, price, and availability before normalization; canonical verification must PASS and risk must ACCEPT. Commit and data shipping remain separately blocked unless separately authorized.
separately_authorized_later_phase.failure_handling: If output is again input.url only or any required field is missing, preserve raw evidence and fail closed: verification FAIL, risk REJECT, commit BLOCKED, data shipped NO.
